div.head: IV Eg 7
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe æfter ænegum ceape ride, cyðe his nehgeburum ymbe hwæt he ride; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, cyðe eác, on hwæs gewitnysse he þone ceap gebohte.
⁊ se ðe æfter agenum ceape ride, cyðe his neahgeburum, ymbe hwæt he ride; ⁊ ðonne he ham cume, cyðe eác, on ðæs gewitnysse he ðone ceap gebohte.

Qui autem de loco ad locum causa emendi, ut prefati sumus, transierit, uicinis et amicorum suorum turbis insinuet, cuius rei instinctu proficissci uelit; et cum iterum domum redierit, palam faciat, in cuius testificatione eandem suam emptionem emerit.
⁊ se ðe æfter ænegum ceape ride, cyðe his neahgeburum ymbe hwæt he ride; ⁊ ðonne he ham cume, cyðe eác on hwæs gewitnysse he ðone ceap gebohte.
And he who sets out to make any purchase shall inform his neighbours of the object of his journey; and when he comes home, he shall also declare who was present as witness when he bought the goods.
And he who rides out to make any purchase is to inform his neighbours what he is going for; and when he comes home he is also to announce in whose witness he bought the goods.
Und wer auf irgend welchen Kauf fortreist, melde seinen Nachbarn, wonach er reisen will; und sobald er heimkommt, melde er auch, unter wessen Zeugenschaft er die Waare gekauft hat.
And whoever rides out after any purchase, let him tell his neighbours what he is riding for; and when he comes home, let him also tell under whose witness he bought the goods.
div.note: C's ‘agenum’ and ‘ðæs’ should be corrected from F (‘ænegum’, ‘hwæs’).
